description: Chart 01 — Venue density heatmap. A binned 2-D histogram of Victoria's ~23,658 licensed-venue coordinates: longitude and latitude are each binned, and colour counts the venues falling in each cell (square-root scale so regional centres stay visible against the Melbourne core). This replaces a raw dot map of 23k overplotted points with a derived density idiom that reads the concentration directly — the bright core is Greater Melbourne, with Geelong, Ballarat and Bendigo as smaller hot cells. Latitude increases upward and longitude rightward, so the grid still reads as a map of the state; the projected maps either side (chart-11, chart-14) carry the coastline. Data: venues_web.csv.
